per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The user interface shall be simple enough that inexperienced users can find a movie, pay, and start watching without more than minimal steps or confusion.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The purchase-and-play (click-to-play) flow shall complete within three minutes for a straightforward, known-movie scenario.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small UI interactions (e.g., search results, opening movie details) shall respond in approximately five seconds or less to avoid user annoyance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Card payment authorisation shall return a definitive result within fifteen seconds from submission to avoid payment abandonment.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial playback startup (time to first frame / usable playback) shall be a matter of seconds and not tens of seconds; specifically, initial buffering should be no more than ten seconds in typical network conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: If initial buffering exceeds the tolerable threshold, the player shall attempt a low-resolution starter stream quickly to reduce perceived startup delay.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pre-paid card redemption from the user perspective shall be as simple as typing a PIN/code with minimal form friction.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Admin tools shall provide generation and tracking of pre-paid codes; this process shall not be manual (no reliance on spreadsheets).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Sensitive payment data (e.g., credit card information) shall not be stored in plain text in the database and shall be protected by encryption and access controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to sensitive payment data shall be limited by role-based access control so that only a small set of trusted admin roles can view or access full payment details.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: High-privilege admin accounts that can access sensitive data shall require stronger authentication, including two-factor authentication.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall log and retain raw transaction logs and administrative access logs so individual movie sale records and access events can be retrieved for dispute resolution and audits.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide daily business metrics (e.g., daily stream counts, revenue, active users) and the ability to query historical daily aggregates for reporting.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site shall target an availability uptime of approximately 99.5% over measurement period.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall achieve 99.5% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall detect and mitigate automated abuse (e.g., bots brute-forcing pre-paid codes, card-testing attacks, content scraping) and generate timely alerts to admins.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operational alerts (e.g., abuse incidents, server health problems) shall be timely and visible via email and a dashboard so multiple admins can see recent incidents.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Privacy practices shall be clearly documented and a visible privacy policy link shall be present on every page and during signup/checkout.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Administrative access and data access events shall be auditable; the system shall log who accessed sensitive data and when so actions can be audited.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The admin dashboards and reporting tools shall support a small number of concurrent users (a handful) without performance degradation during reporting windows.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The visual design shall use big clear buttons, limited choices per screen, helpful defaults, prominent play flow, tooltips, and friendly error messages to support novice users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI shall support localization for key markets including localized language and local currency display in the user interface.

Operational monitoring from day one shall include server uptime, error rates, and unusual traffic pattern detection, with notifications sent to responsible staff when alerts fire (including night-time alerts).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall include protections against duplicate transactions or unintended duplicates caused by retries (e.g., idempotency on payment callbacks) to prevent duplicate records and revenue reconciliation issues.
